android.permission.CAMERA.description: Required to be able to access the camera device for taking photos or capturing video.
android.permission.CAMERA.privacy_risk: Allows the app to secretly record photos or video streams of the user and their surroundings at any time.
abuse_scenarios: Covert video recording and espionage by stalkerware or spyware.
Facial biometric harvesting without explicit real-time consent.
android.permission.CAMERA.remediation: If the app only needs occasional photos, use the Android Photo Picker or ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE intent instead of requesting raw CAMERA permission.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.description: Allows an application to record audio using the device microphone.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.privacy_risk: Enables continuous ambient eavesdropping, recording private spoken conversations, acoustic fingerprinting, and ultrasound beacon tracking.
abuse_scenarios: Stalkerware capturing private meetings and phone calls.
Ad-tech SDKs listening for TV/media ultrasound watermarks.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.remediation: Use system audio intents or clearly disclose when recording is active with distinct visual indicators.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.description: Allows an app to access precise location from GPS, cellular towers, and Wi-Fi beacons (accuracy typically within a few meters).
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.privacy_risk: Exposes exact physical residence, workplace, daily travel routes, medical visits, and real-time physical tracking.
abuse_scenarios: Unconsented geofencing, real-time physical stalking, and selling precise location telemetry to data brokers.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.remediation: Evaluate if coarse location (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) is sufficient for city-level weather or regional content.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.description: Allows an app to access approximate location derived from network location sources such as cell towers and Wi-Fi.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.privacy_risk: Can pinpoint user's neighborhood, town, or transit corridor without GPS precision.
abuse_scenarios: Targeted advertising profiling and regional behavioral pattern tracking.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.remediation: Only request when location is strictly relevant to user utility; never require mandatory grant for non-location apps.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.description: Allows an app to access location in the background when the user is not actively interacting with the app.
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.privacy_risk: Uninterrupted 24/7 surveillance of movements, habits, and associations even while the phone is locked or another app is active.
abuse_scenarios: Covert persistent movement surveillance and automated life-pattern profiling.
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.remediation: Google Play policy strictly restricts background location. Use foreground services with prominent user notification.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.description: Allows an application to read the user's contacts data, including names, phone numbers, email addresses, and relationship notes.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.privacy_risk: Exfiltrates social graph, exposing not only the user's data but also third parties' private unlisted phone numbers and details.
abuse_scenarios: Contact scraping by predatory loan apps, blackmail campaigns, and social spam syndicates.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.remediation: Use the Contacts Provider Contact Picker intent to allow the user to select only single contacts on demand.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.description: Allows an application to write or modify the user's contacts data.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.privacy_risk: Malicious modification or deletion of contacts; injection of phishing URLs into contact entries.
abuse_scenarios: Contact wiping malware or poisoning address books with phishing hyperlinks.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.remediation: Do not request WRITE_CONTACTS unless building a dedicated address book synchronization manager.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.description: Allows an application to read the user's call log, including incoming, outgoing, and missed call numbers, timestamps, and durations.
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.privacy_risk: Reveals sensitive interpersonal communications, hotlines called (e.g. medical, legal, crisis), and relationship dynamics.
abuse_scenarios: Extortion by loan shark apps and spying on communications by stalkerware.
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.remediation: Restricted by Google Play. Only apps acting as the default phone handler are permitted to access this.

android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.description: Allows an application to write (but not read) the user's call log data.
android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.privacy_risk: Malicious apps can erase evidence of fraud calls or inject fraudulent records to impersonate authorities.
abuse_scenarios: Erasing traces of unauthorized toll/premium outbound calls.
android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG.remediation: Only dedicated dialers should request call log modification.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.description: Allows read-only access to phone state, including phone number, cellular network info, active call status, and device identifiers (IMEI/IMSI on older OS).
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.privacy_risk: Can uniquely fingerprint devices across app re-installs, track SIM card replacements, and detect active phone calls.
abuse_scenarios: Persistent cross-app tracking without user consent; call detection for targeted interruptions.
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.remediation: Use READ_PHONE_NUMBERS if only phone number is needed, or rely on TelecomManager without sensitive identifiers.

android.permission.CALL_PHONE.description: Allows an application to initiate a phone call without going through the Dialer user interface for the user to confirm the call.
android.permission.CALL_PHONE.privacy_risk: Can initiate unauthorized calls to premium-rate numbers resulting in immediate monetary loss.
abuse_scenarios: Toll fraud malware dialing expensive foreign or premium rate lines silently in the background.
android.permission.CALL_PHONE.remediation: Use ACTION_DIAL intent instead of ACTION_CALL, allowing the user to review and press the call button.

android.permission.READ_SMS.description: Allows an application to read SMS messages stored on the phone or SIM card.
android.permission.READ_SMS.privacy_risk: Directly compromises two-factor authentication (2FA) SMS codes, banking transaction OTPs, and confidential personal conversations.
abuse_scenarios: Banking trojans intercepting OTP verification codes to drain victim accounts.
Smishing surveillance.
android.permission.READ_SMS.remediation: Use SMS Retriever API or SMS User Consent API for automated OTP entry without requiring READ_SMS permission.

android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.description: Allows an application to receive incoming SMS messages.
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.privacy_risk: Real-time interception of authentication tokens and private communications before user even reads them.
abuse_scenarios: Banking trojans stealthily suppressing OTP notifications and completing financial fraud.
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.remediation: Use the Google Play Services SMS Retriever API for zero-permission OTP verification.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.description: Allows an application to send SMS messages directly without user intervention.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.privacy_risk: Financial theft through outbound premium-rate SMS messages and spreading malware worms to contact lists.
abuse_scenarios: Premium SMS fraud malware generating thousands of dollars in victim telecom billing.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.remediation: Use ACTION_SENDTO intent with 'smsto:' URI scheme to delegate message sending to user's preferred SMS app.

android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.description: Allows an application to read the user's calendar events and meeting details.
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.privacy_risk: Exposes confidential business meetings, personal doctors' appointments, flights, and attendee lists.
abuse_scenarios: Corporate espionage, profiling schedules, and social engineering preparation.
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.remediation: Use CalendarContract intents for event viewing or editing rather than demanding raw read permission.

android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.description: Allows an application to create, edit, or delete calendar events without notifying the user.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.privacy_risk: Phishing event injection into user calendars and deletion of critical schedule records.
abuse_scenarios: Calendar spam phishing attacks injecting scam links into default notifications.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.remediation: Use ACTION_INSERT with Events.CONTENT_URI to allow the user to review new events before adding.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.description: Allows an application to read from external shared storage (photos, documents, downloads).
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.privacy_risk: Mass exfiltration of personal photos, financial tax documents, chat backups, and private downloads.
abuse_scenarios: Data harvesting malware scanning SD card and shared downloads for identity documents and private photos.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.remediation: Adopt Scoped Storage and Storage Access Framework (SAF) or Android Photo Picker on Android 10+.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.description: Allows an application to write or modify files on external shared storage.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.privacy_risk: Overwriting, corrupting, or encrypting user files across the entire shared memory space.
abuse_scenarios: Ransomware encrypting user media, downloading malicious secondary payloads into shared folders.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.remediation: Use app-specific internal or external directories (context.getExternalFilesDir()) which require zero permissions.

android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.description: Allows an application to access data from sensors that monitor physical conditions, such as heart rate monitors.
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.privacy_risk: Direct extraction of intimate biometric and health conditions (cardiac anomalies, physical exertion).
abuse_scenarios: Selling sensitive user health indicators to insurers and profiling health vulnerabilities.
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.remediation: Explicitly explain healthcare necessity and ensure compliance with medical privacy frameworks (HIPAA/GDPR Health).

android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.description: Allows an application to recognize physical activities such as walking, riding a bicycle, driving a car, or standing still.
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.privacy_risk: Detailed life habit profiling, commuting mode analysis, and continuous behavioral telemetry.
abuse_scenarios: Ad profiling based on lifestyle routines and real-time transit state.
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.remediation: Only request if app offers fitness or step counting core functionality.

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Allows an app to post notifications (Android 13+).
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.privacy_risk: Spam notifications, social engineering scams, and deceptive system warnings.
abuse_scenarios: Deceptive scam popups mimicking Google system alerts to trick users into installing adware.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.remediation: Request runtime permission only when user enables alerts in app settings.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.description: Allows an app to create windows shown on top of all other applications (display overlays).
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.privacy_risk: Enables tapjacking attacks, overlay phishing (drawing fake login boxes over banking apps), and click-fraud.
abuse_scenarios: Banking trojans cloaking authentic bank apps with invisible or identical phishing input forms to capture passwords.
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.remediation: Avoid overlay permissions. Use picture-in-picture (PiP) mode for video players or bubbles for messaging.

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.description: Allows an application to request installation of packages outside official app stores.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.privacy_risk: Dropper malware mechanism: downloads and prompts the installation of hidden secondary malicious APKs.
abuse_scenarios: Dropper trojans masquerading as benign utilities to download banking trojans or ransomware payloads.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.remediation: Distribute application updates strictly via official app stores (Google Play) rather than self-updating APK droppers.

android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.description: Allows an app to collect component usage statistics, identifying which apps the user opens, how often, and for how long.
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.privacy_risk: Total visibility into user app habits (dating apps, cryptocurrency wallets, health trackers, secure messengers).
abuse_scenarios: Banking trojans detecting when a specific bank app is launched to trigger an overlay attack at the exact millisecond.
android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS.remediation: Restrict use to digital wellbeing or enterprise device management tools.

android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.description: Must be required by an AccessibilityService to ensure that only the system can bind to it.
android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.privacy_risk: Highest risk vector on Android: grants complete read and write control over screen contents, keylogging, and auto-clicking.
abuse_scenarios: Advanced Android malware abusing Accessibility to read 2FA codes, automate fund transfers, and disable antivirus software.
android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.remediation: Accessibility services should solely be built for genuine assistive technologies for users with disabilities.

android.permission.INTERNET.description: Allows applications to open network sockets and send/receive data over the internet.
android.permission.INTERNET.privacy_risk: Exfiltration highway. When paired with sensitive permissions (camera, location, contacts), enables remote data leakage.
abuse_scenarios: Exfiltration conduit for harvested personal data to remote Command & Control (C2) servers.
android.permission.INTERNET.remediation: Use HTTPS with certificate pinning (network_security_config.xml) to safeguard all transmitted telemetry.

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.description: Allows applications to access information about networks (e.g. Wi-Fi or cellular connected).
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.privacy_risk: Allows fingerprinting connectivity state and scheduling large exfiltrations strictly over Wi-Fi.
abuse_scenarios: Silent background upload scheduling when user is connected to unmetered Wi-Fi.
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.remediation: Standard utility permission; ensure no private data is collected alongside network status.

android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.description: Allows an application to receive the ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED broadcast sent after the system finishes booting.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.privacy_risk: Enables persistence across device reboots; spyware can start running immediately without user launching the app.
abuse_scenarios: Malware auto-start persistence to re-establish C2 channels immediately on device power-up.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.remediation: Use WorkManager for periodic background jobs instead of launch-on-boot receivers whenever possible.

android.permission.VIBRATE.privacy_risk: Low risk. Primarily used for tactile feedback and notifications.
abuse_scenarios: Annoying adware triggering constant vibration to force user attention.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.description: Allows using PowerManager WakeLocks to keep processor from sleeping or screen from dimming.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.privacy_risk: Battery drain and keeping the device awake for continuous covert telemetry or cryptomining.
abuse_scenarios: Background cryptocurrency mining or constant microphone recording while screen appears dark.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.remediation: Avoid manual wake locks; use WorkManager or JobScheduler.

combo_rules.name: Covert Audiovisual Surveillance & Exfiltration
combo_rules.explanation: App has simultaneous access to the microphone, camera, and internet. This combination creates severe spyware capability to silently record surroundings, take photos, and immediately exfiltrate them to remote servers.

combo_rules.name: Persistent 24/7 Geolocation Tracking
combo_rules.explanation: App can track the user's high-precision location continuously even when the app is closed, and beam real-time coordinates over the internet. Characteristic of commercial stalkerware and invasive ad-trackers.

combo_rules.name: Financial OTP & 2FA Interception
combo_rules.explanation: App can read incoming SMS messages and transmit data over the network. This pattern is commonly exploited by banking trojans to intercept one-time passwords (OTPs) and bypass two-factor authentication.

combo_rules.name: Social Graph & Contact Scraping
combo_rules.explanation: App can harvest the user's full phone book and upload it to external databases. This exposes not only the device owner but also contacts, friends, and colleagues without their awareness.

combo_rules.name: Deceptive Screen Overlay & Tapjacking
combo_rules.explanation: App can draw overlays on top of any other app while communicating with remote servers. Attackers use this to display counterfeit credential-prompt dialogs over authentic banking or email apps.

combo_rules.name: Shared Storage Exfiltration & Tampering
combo_rules.explanation: App can modify or wipe shared files and sync them remotely. Untrusted apps with this permission can inspect downloaded documents or stage ransomware-style payloads.

combo_rules.name: Auto-Start Persistence & Surveillance
combo_rules.explanation: App registers to start running automatically as soon as the phone boots, enabling persistent unprompted background operations.
